title: 第31章 李青山暴怒，狂殴赵贵一家子

第31章 李青山暴怒，狂殴赵贵一家子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

存书签

“赵强，我干你姥姥！”

一道怒骂从身后响起，赵强转身望去，正见到李青山宛若一只猛虎般朝着自己冲过来，眼神中满是怒火。

“李青山，你要干什么？”

“不许动手，不许动手……！”

赵强被吓得浑身一个激灵，李青山打架的手段，赵强可是领教过的，声音都夹杂着几分颤音道。

“嘭……！”

下一秒。

李青山已经冲上前去，一脚踹在赵强的胸口，直接将其硬生生踹飞了出去。

没错，踹飞了出去。

一百多斤的汉子，直接倒飞了出去。

在周围村民看来，夸张的很，但就这么发生在自己眼前。

赵强感觉自己被一头牛撞到，胸口的骨头都快要碎了，面目扭曲，身体重重落在地上，惊起满地的尘土。

还未等到赵强惨叫出声音来。

李青山便已经再次冲了上去，一阵拳打脚踢，如雨点一般落在赵强的身上。

“疼疼疼……救命啊……杀人了，杀人了……！”

“爹，救我，救我啊！”

赵强被打的疼痛难忍，对着自家老爹大声喊道。

“李青山，你个二流子在干什么？”

“不许打我儿子，不许打我儿子，我跟你拼命你信不信……！”

赵贵见自己宝贝疙瘩儿子被打了，顿时心疼的不得了，连忙冲上前去想要拉开李青山，结果刚刚碰到李青山的胳膊，便听到李青山炸雷般的声音道：“你个老东西，竟敢打老子？”

“啥？”

“我什么时候……！”

赵贵刚想要反驳，一个拳头却已经落在自己眼眶上，一只眼睛顿时一黑，还未来得及惨叫，狂风暴雨一般的拳头便不断的落在自己身上。

“哎呦哎呦……疼疼疼……！”

“李青山，你个二流子你敢打我……救命啊……杀人啦……！”

“快去喊村长，快去喊村长啊……李青山这个二流子发疯了……！”

赵贵倒在地上惨叫，浑身上下挨了个遍。

“李青山，你敢打我家男人和儿子，我挠死你……！”

赵贵的婆娘仗着自己是女人，顿时张牙舞爪的朝着李青山冲了上来。

再怎么，这李青山也不敢打自己一个女人吧？

“老婆娘，你要干什么？”

李青山一只手抓住赵贵婆娘的手腕，另外一只手猛地抽了过去。

“啪！”

一道清脆的声音响起，五根手指印顿时浮现在赵贵婆娘的脸上。/

赵贵婆娘一脸懵逼。

万万没想到，李青山竟然会对自己一个女人下手。

然而。

让赵贵婆娘更加想不到的，还在后面呢。

"Zhao Qiang, let me fuck your grandma!"

An angry curse sounded from behind, Zhao Qiang turned around and saw Li Qingshan rushing towards him like a tiger, his eyes full of anger.

"Li Qingshan, what do you want to do?"

"Don't do it, don't do it...!"

Zhao Qiang was so frightened that his whole body trembled. Zhao Qiang had learned Li Qingshan's fighting methods before, and his voice was mixed with a bit of vibrato.

"Bang...!"

The next second.

Li Qingshan had already rushed forward and kicked Zhao Qiang in the chest, sending him flying away.

That's right, he was kicked out.

The man, who weighed more than 100 kilograms, flew backwards.

In the eyes of the surrounding villagers, it was an exaggeration, but it happened right in front of me.

Zhao Qiang felt like he was hit by a cow, and the bones in his chest were about to break. His face was distorted, and his body fell heavily to the ground, stirring up dust all over the ground.

Before Zhao Qiang screamed out.

Li Qingshan rushed forward again, and a flurry of punches and kicks fell on Zhao Qiang like raindrops.

"It hurts, it hurts...Help...it's killing people, killing people...!"

"Dad, save me, save me!"

Zhao Qiang was in unbearable pain from the beating and shouted loudly to his father.

"Li Qingshan, what are you doing, you idiot?"

"Don't hit my son, don't hit my son, believe it or not, I will fight you tooth and nail...!"

When Zhao Gui saw that his precious son had been beaten, he felt extremely distressed. He rushed forward to try to pull Li Qingshan away, but as soon as he touched Li Qingshan's arm, he heard Li Qingshan's thunderous voice saying: "You old man, how dare you hit me?"

"What?"

"When did I...!"

Zhao Guigang wanted to retort, but a fist fell on his eye socket. One of his eyes suddenly went black. Before he could scream, fists like a violent storm continued to fall on him.

"Ouch, ouch...it hurts, it hurts...!"

"Li Qingshan, you second-rate idiot, how dare you hit me...help me...kill someone...!"

"Go and call the village chief, go and call the village chief... Li Qingshan, this second-rate guy, is crazy...!"

Zhao Gui fell to the ground and screamed, being beaten all over his body.

"Li Qingshan, if you dare to hit my man and son, I will scratch you to death...!"

Zhao Gui's mother-in-law took advantage of the fact that she was a woman and immediately rushed towards Li Qingshan with her teeth and claws bared.

No matter what, Li Qingshan wouldn't dare to hit a woman like him, right?

"Old lady, what do you want to do?"

Li Qingshan grabbed Mrs. Zhao Gui's wrist with one hand and jerked it away with the other hand.

"Crack!"

A clear voice sounded, and five finger prints suddenly appeared on Mrs. Zhao Gui's face./

Madam Zhao Gui looked confused.

He never expected that Li Qingshan would attack a woman like him.

However.

What Mrs. Zhao Gui did not expect even more was yet to come.
